1.content: Assign a high positive score to moves that strictly decrease Manhattan distance to the goal while staying on safe cells. Assign a strong negative score to any move that would land on a hazard cell, ensuring this penalty overrides any distance‑based benefit. Assign a moderate negative score to safe moves that increase distance, and a neutral (zero) score to moves that leave distance unchanged.
